items.claim: Elise Reed gets finished at the lower-level ladies fights in the UFC.
items.quote: Elise Reed is not very good. She gets finished at the lower-level ladies fights in the UFC.

items.claim: Chanelle Dyer is a pretty damn promising kickboxer with power and defensive grappling ability.
items.quote: Chanelle Dyer is a pretty damn promising kickboxer. Sometimes she's hot, sometimes she's a little cold, but she has some power, some kinetic energy behind her strikes. She's got some defensive grappling ability

items.claim: West Shultz is a guard-pulling fighter who relies on Hail Mary submissions because he lacks skills and heart.
items.quote: West Shultz is just a guard-pulling, throw-up-a-submission Hail Mary because he doesn't have the skills or the heart to deal with other places.

items.claim: Jackson McVey should be able to out strike West Shultz and deal with the grappling situations.
items.quote: Jackson McVey should be able to out strike him handily. Jackson McVey should be able to deal with the grappling situations.

items.claim: Gage Young has a pretty good jab and right hand, with quality UFC wins over Masha Day and Thiago Moises.
items.quote: Gage Young has a pretty good jab, pretty nice right hand he throws over the top. He's got some quality wins inside the UFC. I mean quality. Masha Day, Thiago Moises

items.claim: Giga Chikadze will win the rounds on the feet against Stan Dorsemville.
items.quote: I think on the feet you got to think Giga Chikadze is going to be able to win these rounds.

items.claim: Stan Dorsemville does not have a full camp for this fight.
items.quote: Stan doesn't have a full camp on this.

items.claim: Ryan Couture is moving up in weight for this fight.
items.quote: Ryan Couture is moving UP IN WEIGHT.

items.claim: Nasrat Haqparast's boxing is pretty mid according to a former training partner.
items.quote: I talked to a former training partner of Nasrat Haqparast... he did say that Nasrat's boxing's pretty mid.

items.claim: Shamil Gaziev has poor striking defense with a wide head making him an easy target to hit.
items.quote: the Blob does have some poor striking defense. His head's like this big and Brando Parisic couldn't miss him.

items.claim: Larian Douglas has great hand speed and fast combinations.
items.quote: If you guys just saw his last fight against Julian Erosa, I was blown away by the hand speed. Oh my god. This dude rips fast combinations.
